name: Test Impact Evidence
description: Evidence-based test plans for AI-assisted changes, with mapping freshness checks and explicit fallback scope.

composer.prompt: Use test-impact-evidence to plan tests for this change. Read its plan reference and produce test-impact-plan.json and test-impact-plan.md from the available evidence.

resources.label: Test Impact Evidence
resources.description: Connect changed files, test scope and execution evidence without mistaking a proposed plan for passing CI.

zh-CN.name: 测试影响证据
zh-CN.description: 为 AI 辅助代码变更制定有证据的测试计划，检查映射时效并明确扩大验证范围的条件。

composer.prompt: 使用 test-impact-evidence 技能及其计划参考文件，分析当前变更并生成 test-impact-plan.json 和 test-impact-plan.md。

test-impact-evidence.label: 测试影响证据
test-impact-evidence.description: 关联变更、测试范围与执行证据，区分建议执行的计划和已有测试结果。
